rows.note: Use this for good luck, including a favorable outcome; it is the all-purpose choice for positive fortune.

example.english: I had good fortune this time and won the grand prize.
example.traditional: 我今次真係好運，抽中咗頭獎。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 hou2 wan6 cau1 zung3 zo2 tau4 zoeng2

rows.note: Use this for a person's total wealth or net worth rather than for one isolated payment.

example.english: He built a fortune of several hundred million through business.
example.traditional: 佢靠做生意累積咗幾億身家。
example.jyutping: keoi5 kaau3 zou6 sang1 ji3 leoi5 zik1 zo2 gei2 jik1 san1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this for a large sum of money, especially when saying that something costs a fortune.

example.english: Buying this flat costs a fortune.
example.traditional: 買呢層樓要成一大筆錢。
example.jyutping: maai5 ni1 cang4 lau4 jiu3 seng4 jat1 daai6 bat1 cin2

rows.note: Use this for fate or the course of someone's life, rather than simply a lucky outcome.

example.english: Nobody can predict their own fortune.
example.traditional: 冇人可以預測自己嘅命運。
example.jyutping: mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 jyu6 cak1 zi6 gei2 ge3 ming6 wan6
